full_action.homogeneous_space: B1 is isomorphic as an S3-set to S3/S2

selector_implication: Neither the S3 homogeneous-set structure nor the A3 torsor subaction supplies a distinguished donor origin.

torsor_audit.canonical_subgroup: A3 is the unique order-3 normal/commutator subgroup of S3.
torsor_audit.reason_S3: Not free: each donor has a nontrivial order-2 stabilizer.
torsor_audit.reason_Z3: A3 is cyclic of order 3, but choosing which nonidentity 3-cycle is '+1' versus '-1' is extra orientation; full S3 odd permutations exchange the two generators.
